intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) Côte du village de Mûr-de-Bretagne

story: Team Visma | Lease a Bike and UAE Team Emirates - XRG controlled the race behind a break with former Tour winner Geraint Thomas. On the Mûr-de-Bretagne, Pogacar attacked early, joined by Evenepoel and Vingegaard. Led out by Narvaez, Pogacar won the uphill sprint ahead of Vingegaard to reclaim the yellow jersey.
